# rhcs_external_auth_provider (Resource)

Manages an external authentication provider on a ready ROSA HCP cluster. The cluster must be created with external authentication enabled. OCM permits one external authentication provider per cluster, and a newly created provider can take a few minutes to become effective. `issuer_ca` contains PEM certificate content, such as `file("ca.pem")`, not a file path. `extra_scopes` applies to the console client; no `profile` scope is added implicitly.

Import with `<cluster_id>,<name>`. The OCM API may not return a console client secret, so import cannot recover it. Set `console_client_secret` in configuration before updating a confidential console client. Updates to the console client fail safely if the provider also has clients for other components, because their secrets cannot be preserved reliably in a replacement client list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cluster_id" {
  description = "ID of a ready ROSA HCP cluster with external authentication enabled."
  type        = string
}

variable "console_client_id" {
  description = "OIDC client ID registered for the OpenShift console."
  type        = string
}

variable "console_client_secret" {
  description = "OIDC client secret for the OpenShift console."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "issuer_url" {
  description = "HTTPS URL of the OIDC token issuer."
  type        = string
}

resource "rhcs_external_auth_provider" "main" {
  cluster          = var.cluster_id
  name             = "example"
  issuer_url       = var.issuer_url
  issuer_audiences = [var.console_client_id]
  # Optional: provide PEM certificate content when the issuer uses a private CA.
  # issuer_ca = file("ca.pem")
  console_client_id     = var.console_client_id
  console_client_secret = var.console_client_secret
  # Request only if this identity provider requires the profile scope.
  extra_scopes = ["profile"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) ID of the ROSA HCP cluster. The cluster must have external authentication enabled.
- `issuer_audiences` (Set of String) Audiences for which tokens from the issuer are valid (one to ten values).
- `issuer_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the token issuer.
- `name` (String) Name of the external authentication provider; used as its OCM ID.

### Optional

- `claim_mapping_groups_claim` (String) ID token claim used to map groups.
- `claim_mapping_username_claim` (String) ID token claim used to construct usernames.
- `claim_validation_rule` (List of String) Rules for token claims in claim:required_value format. The first colon separates the claim; later colons belong to required_value.
- `console_client_id` (String) Client ID used by the OpenShift console. Must also appear in issuer_audiences.
- `console_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret for the OpenShift console application.
- `extra_scopes` (Set of String) Additional scopes requested by the OpenShift console client.
- `issuer_ca` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate bundle content for the issuer (for example, file("ca.pem")).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the external authentication provider.
